admin.title: Admin hand manual
admin.intro: Use this guide when riggin' up Qlicker fer yer institution or helpin' officers an' crew.
admin.summary: Th' admin quarterdeck saves after short pauses, so recap sensitive values like SSO certificates, cargo hold credentials, stash policy, newly issued 2-bell voyage defaults, an' video rigging carefully afore ye leave a tab.
quickStart: Confirm institution-wide defaults in Rigging afore a new term sets sail.
Rig up stash, cargo hold, SSO, an' video in th' admin UI afore onboardin' hands when yer deployment depends on shared services.
Use th' Hands an' Ships tabs to vouch fer that ranks, enrollments, an' afloat ships match reality.

sections.title: Start with th' required formats an' deployment assumptions
sections.subtitle: Most admin troubles come from a small mismatch between expected field formats an' th' environment.
bullets: Run th' server, client, an' database with th' deployment environment values ye actually plan to support afore testin' admin workflows.

Allowed missive domains be a comma-separated list; login/voyage expiry be a whole number o' minutes fer newly issued access an' freshen voyages; locale, date format, an' time format become global defaults.
SSO values be plain text fields fer URLs, entity IDs, an' attribute monikers. Certificates an' keys should be pasted exactly as yer identity provider supplies them.
Cargo hold forms expect th' provider-specific fields revealed in th' UI, an' ye should always confirm th' setup by uploadin' an image afterward.
Use th' Stash tab to confirm th' scheduled stash time, th' 7 daily / 4 weekly / 12 monthly retention defaults, an' th' latest run standing afore relyin' on th' system fer salvage.
In Profile, choose Daylight or Night Watch under Ship’s Colours. Yer choice saves itself and sails with yer account across voyages and devices.
sections.note: When someone reports a hand-facin' issue, compare this guide with th' professor or crew member guide so th' support answer matches th' current workflow.

sections.title: Configure local, S3, or Azure cargo hold spot-on
sections.subtitle: Cargo hold now lives in th' database, but th' cloud provider still has to be shipshape.
bullets: New deployments start on local cargo hold by default, an' th' picked backend be stowed in Qlicker's Rigging document rather than in runtime environment variables.
Local cargo hold be th' simplest choice, but th' server environment must keep uploaded files safe across restarts an' deployments.
Amazon S3 mode needs bucket, region, access key ID, secret key, an' optional endpoint plus path-style support fer compatible services such as MinIO.
Azure Blob mode needs cargo hold account, access key, an' container moniker. Th' bucket or container must already exist an' let th' app read an' write.
Set th' maximum hoist up width to control image resizing afore hoist up. Th' default be 1920px.
Set th' avatar thumbnail size to control how large cropped dossier thumbnails get generated. Th' default be 512px.
After savin' cargo hold changes, hoist up a sample image from th' rich-text editor an' th' dossier page, then confirm both th' full image an' avatar thumbnail render spot-on.
sections.warning: Treat cargo hold keys an' private credentials like buried treasure maps — secrets. Rotate 'em if they're ever exposed.

sections.title: Set up SSO an' institution-wide video afore openin' access broadly
sections.subtitle: These rigging affect how folk board th' platform an' how officers use real-time tools.
bullets: Hoist SSO only after ye have th' identity provider entry doubloon, logout URL, entity ID, attribute mappings, an' th' right certificates or private keys.
Paste certificates an' private keys exactly as issued. Private keys usually include BEGIN an' END markers an' shouldn't be edited by hand.
Leave th' advanced SAML rigging on their defaults unless yer IdP requires somethin' different. Th' default route set presented to th' IdP remains th' legacy /SSO/SAML2 surface.
If another IdP expects th' newer /api/v1/auth/sso callback/logout routes, switch th' route mode only after retestin' metadata, login, callback, an' logout end to end.
Hoist Jitsi only after th' Jitsi domain an' optional Etherpad domain be right, then pick which ships can use video.
Retest login, logout, an' a video-hoisted ship after every change so officers ain't surprised durin' class time.
sections.warning: Incorrect SSO values can block sign-in fer every hand, so make changes durin' a maintenance window whenever possible.

sections.title: Oversee hands, ships, an' rank-based support
sections.subtitle: Once global rigging be right, th' Hands an' Ships tabs become yer daily support tools.
bullets: Hunt hands by moniker or missive, change ranks, vouch fer missive addresses, chart accounts, reset local secret words, an' open per-hand properties when local missive login or professor promotion rules must change.
Strike a hand when ye need to block sign-in without erasin' th' account history, then salvage th' same account later if access should return.
When institution-wide SSO be hoisted, non-admin hands need th' per-account allow-missive-login exception afore local missive sign-in an' secret word-reset missive become available.
Recap ships an' hand details to confirm th' right crew member, TA, an' officer memberships, term labels, activity state, an' boarding readiness afore troubleshootin' a professor workflow.
Crew member-only hands who teach a ship appear as TAs in th' admin UI, but that's spyglass-only wordin' rather than a new stored rank.
Admins can open th' professor an' crew member manuals directly from th' manual switcher on these pages, which be handy when reproducin' a reported issue from another rank's doubloon o' view.

Open Hands → Oversee bulletins. Scrawl Headline an' Word at th' top, pick all hands, crew, or officers under Send to whom, set th' dates, then Yarn bulletin an' Aye, Confirm. Bulletins in yer avatar menu be a read-only inbox, not where ye write; no missive be sent.
sections.warning: Rank changes an' SSO login approvals take effect immediately, so confirm th' request afore savin'.

sections.title: Watch th' host and busiest hours aboard
sections.subtitle: Open Usage Tallies to compare CPU engines, memory hold, network riggin', and active hands.
bullets: Choose 6 hours, 24 hours, or 7 days aboard. Refresh fetches new tallies; th' page ain't askin' constantly. Hover or tap a history chart to inspect th' nearest time bucket an' each curve's tally. Focus th' chart and use Left/Right or Home/End; Escape stows th' readout. Missing values say No tally, never guessed between points.
CPU and memory cover th' whole Linux host. Network shows bytes taken aboard and sent ashore each second on th' selected interfaces, includin' other cargo aboard.

Recently active means a hand made an authenticated API request in th' past 15 minutes by default. Idle signed-in hands may fall off th' tally, and ranks may overlap. Th' memory card shows used, total, an' available RAM. Automatic network selection favors non-tunnel default-route interfaces so VPN an' uplink cargo ain't counted twice. Check th' interface names; rates be KiB/s or MiB/s, not bits each second.
Th' logbook starts when system-monitor is rigged and keeps seven days. Charts average resources over 1, 5, or 30 minutes and show th' highest sampled crew count.
Compare busiest watches with th' charts. Check sample time and watch events fer stale tidings, errors, and recovery. Operators can read th' full Docker logs.
sections.note: Th' browser capture shows example tallies; use yer own logbook to investigate trouble.

professor.title: Professor hand manual
professor.intro: Use this guide to build ships, organize riddles, run voyages or reckonings, an' read crew member results.
professor.summary: Good ship topics an' consistent semester monikers make almost every later workflow easier: hunt, copyin', load/unload, an' gradin' all benefit from a tidy ship structure.
quickStart: Chart th' ship with a consistent semester moniker such as Fall 2026 or Winter 2027.
Add ship topics first, then set up watches if ye plan to use 'em fer in-class organization or reportin'.
Build voyages from th' ship page, decide which ones be interactive or reckoning-based, an' recap results after crew have taken part.

sections.title: Chart a ship an' add topics afore ye scale up
sections.subtitle: A clean ship setup saves time when ye copy or hunt later.
bullets: Th' ship creation dialog combines a semester season an' year into one label, which ye can edit later if ye need a custom or legacy format. Search sessions starts unfurled and can be stowed. Enablin’ chat or AI keeps Course Settings selected; Back to course restores th’ tab ye sailed from. Show Stats follows new attempts in th’ presentation window without reloadin’.
Use ship rigging to oversee th' title, boarding rules, reckoning time display, afloat state, an' whether crew may access drill riddles, th' ship riddle chest, an' drill voyages.
Add ship topics early so yer own riddles stay organized an' crew can hunt th' chest material ye make in plain sight to 'em when drill-riddle access be hoisted.

Each ship has an boarding or board code that crew enter from their quarterdeck to board that specific ship. Share th' current code with yer class an' amend it in ship rigging if ye need to stop an old code from bein' reused.

Open th' ship's Crew or Officers tab → Oversee bulletins. Scrawl Headline an' Word at th' top; pick everyone in this ship fer crew an' officers together, or target either group. Set th' dates, then Yarn bulletin an' Aye, Confirm. Bulletins in yer avatar menu be a read-only inbox; no missive be sent.
sections.note: If ye teach similar ships each term, use th' same namin' convention so copied material stays easy to spot.

screenshot.description: Ship pages gather voyages, rigging, riddle-chest tools, an' ledgers into one workspace.

sections.title: Set up watches afore ye need 'em in class
sections.subtitle: Watches work best when classes an' membership be prepared afore a underway voyage begins.
bullets: Use th' Watches tab on th' ship page to chart a class, pick how many watches it should contain, an' rechristen watches if ye want clearer labels than th' defaults.
Each crew member can belong to only one watch inside a class, but th' same ship can have multiple classes fer different activities or labs.
Add or toss crew directly in th' watch management view, or load a CSV when ye already have a roster ready in spreadsheet form.
Haul down th' CSV unload when ye want a record o' th' current watch makeup, or when ye want a startin' doubloon fer editin' an' re-uploadin' membership.
If ye use watches fer turnout analysis or watch-specific activities, vouch fer th' membership afore launchin' th' relevant voyage.
sections.note: Watches be ship-specific, so copied voyages don't replace th' need to recap watch classes in th' destination ship.

sections.title: Build voyages with riddles, slides, an' visibility in mind
sections.subtitle: Voyages be ordered learnin' voyages, not just containers.
bullets: Use th' voyage editor to set th' voyage moniker, blurb, visibility, reviewability, secret code requirement, reckoning window, extensions, an' multi-pick scorin' method. Create yer tags in Course Settings, then pick the tags that describe this session and its questions.
Add new riddles, pick from th' riddle chest, load voyage JSON, or insert slides anywhere in th' sequence.
Slides be content-only pages, so they're ideal fer instructions, worked examples, or parley prompts between reckoned riddles.
Riddle visibility matters: keep private content private, share ship-public material intentionally, an' use Qlicker-wide visibility only when broad reuse be really desired.
Use Unfurl all previews or Furl all previews above the question manifest, or toggle each question preview on its own, arr!

Use Marks visible beside Reviewable in the voyage list, editor, or review page to release scores without opening review. Reviewable hoists or lowers mark visibility with it. With Reviewable off, ye can explicitly release marks. Wait until the voyage and all extensions end, arr!
sections.warning: Once a riddle has reply data, some edits be intentionally restricted to protect th' meanin' o' past results.

screenshot.description: Th' voyage editor keeps orderin', rigging, an' load/unload deeds together so ye can build a complete activity in one place.

sections.title: Use th' rich-text editor fer math, images, an' clear prompts
sections.subtitle: Riddles, slides, solutions, an' some holler fields all support rich content.
bullets: Use formatting tools like bold, lists, colors, links, an' code only when they make th' prompt easier to read, not busier.
Simple LaTeX examples include $a^2+b^2=c^2$, $\frac{1}{2}$, an' $$\int_0^1 x^2\,dx=\frac{1}{3}$$.
Hoist up images directly in th' editor, resize 'em fer readability, an' preview th' rendered result afore publishin'.
Keep yer wordin' short so crew can focus on th' concept rather than on decipherin' th' prompt.

sections.title: Use th' chest, load/unload, an' copy tools to prepare efficiently
sections.subtitle: Once th' ship structure be in place, reuse becomes one o' th' fastest ways to prepare.
bullets: Use th' riddle chest to hunt by ship, type, labels, voyages, an' approval state; unload or load JSON bundles when sharin' content.
Copy voyages within a ship or across yer ships after checkin' that th' destination ship topics still make sense fer th' loaded material.
Recap loaded or copied content afore class so visibility, secret codes, reckoning dates, an' labels match th' destination ship.

sections.title: Run interactive voyages an' reckonings intentionally
sections.subtitle: Different voyage types be best fer different teachin' moments.
bullets: Interactive voyages be fer underway teachin': ye control navigation, reply windows, statistics, answer reveals, stabs, an' th' spyglass window. Individual extensions work after th’ quiz be Ended. Active or upcoming extensions bar review; grantin’ one stows existing review an’ hides published grades. Recalculate grades after extensions finish before publishin’ again. Submitted quizzes stay locked.

Fer short-answer riddles, th' professor control view always keeps th' full reply list in plain sight; a separate flip controls whether crew an' th' spyglass window see that shared list. Th’ spyglass window follows numbered question buttons an’ Previous/Next, includin’ visibility, stats, correct answers, an’ new attempts. Crew names stay hidden in projected chat an’ responses; reconnectin’ restores th’ current voyage state.

Reckonings be scheduled windows where crew answer on their own timeline. Use start an' end times plus extensions fer accommodation workflows. Th’ course an’ editor status menus steer th’ same setting. Choose Underway to open th’ quiz regardless o’ dates an’ stay in th’ editor, with a link to live results. Choose date-controlled status to follow th’ schedule, or Docked to close general access while keepin’ individual extensions afloat.
Drill reckonings feel more like guided rehearsal an' be well suited fer self-study or optional reinforcement.
If a voyage depends on secret codes, watches, or in plain sight statistics, confirm those rigging afore crew begin joinin'.

Voyage lists keep hunt, filters, an' pagination inside Hunt voyages. While an interactive voyage be underway, openin' its card joins th' underway controls directly; underway reckoning cards still open th' editor.

Replies an' musters be stowed without the crew's names. This voyage won't be scored. The mask can't be changed once crew have boarded or replied. Masked live reckonings and untied answer lists update after at least four new mateys answer the riddle and attempt. Names and answer times stay hidden. After the voyage ends, replies be released for each riddle and attempt with at least four mateys, tied across eligible riddles. Smaller crews show their true reply count with a hidden-replies notice; overall percentages stay hidden while any replies be withheld. A rare reply may still reveal someone. An info banner in live Controls explains the four-crewmate minimum while stats be hidden, then shows the released answer count and batchin’ rule.

The session editor shows sharin’ controls only when the course allows activity sharin’. Use the voyage switch to open or close sharing; the live code stays in sight after a refresh and can be forged anew. First enable code sharing in course settings, matey; it starts off. Turnin’ it off scuttles old codes and outside access. Clear individual quiz extensions afore sharing; they stay gone thereafter. To invite signed-in mateys outside yer ship, make a quiz or live voyage in the course and forge an S- activity code in the editor. Copy it at once; a new code bars new use of the old one, and disabling it revokes outside entry. Turnin’ sharing back on uses the same code; only forgin’ a new one replaces it. In a named voyage, enrolled mateys may earn marks; guest replies be tracked without marks. Turn on masking fer a survey with no marks fer any matey. Choose named or masked replies before the first code use. After the voyage ends, replies be released for each riddle and attempt with at least four mateys, tied across eligible riddles. Smaller crews show their true reply count with a hidden-replies notice; overall percentages stay hidden while any replies be withheld. A rare answer may still reveal a matey. The rotating live boarding code still applies when enabled. Activity codes won't work while the activity be a Draft, even fer past crewmates. The same code works once the captain publishes the activity. Activity codes be S- followed by seven letters or digits. The active code also appears in the captain’s live session controls.

If the captain moves a live voyage to Upcoming, mateys see a waitin’ screen till it sails Live again. Draft sends enrolled crew back to the course and guests to their dashboard. Saved answers stay aboard.

Fer an Upcomin’ interactive session, students can choose Open the waitin’ deck; guests can enter its S- activity code. Waitin’ records no attendance. The captain can still edit the session and require a live join code. When the session goes Live, crew wait fer a question or enter the code once the captain opens the join period.

sections.title: Use boardin' codes fer attendance an' admission
sections.subtitle: Control boardin' to a live interactive voyage, then admit late crew one by one.
bullets: Th' course enrollment code joins th' ship's course; th' six-digit voyage code admits enrolled crew to one live voyage. Fer attendance-controlled boardin', enable Require Secret code before crew join.

When an interactive session goes Live, Qlicker picks the first question or slide if none be active. The current active item stays put. A newly picked first item stays hidden till ye reveal it, just as with Launch. Launchin' won't open boardin' by itself. In th' live controls, enable Board Spell an' open th' presentation window to show th' current code in class. Crew open th' live voyage an' enter that code.
Set refresh between 5 an' 120 seconds; keep th' officer's live controls open fer automatic rotation. Refresh th' code to replace it straightaway. Crew not yet aboard must use th' current code.
After check-in, close Board Spell but keep Require Secret code enabled. Without that requirement, enrolled crew can board a runnin' voyage without a code.

Fer late crew, open th' students panel, expand Waitin' to board, filter by name or email, an' choose Admit beside th' verified crewmate. They must be enrolled. Manual admission works while th' voyage runs even with Board Spell closed.
Waitin' to board lists enrolled crew who haven't joined, not necessarily folk online or askin' to board.

Admission lasts fer that voyage, by code or officer alike. Crew can leave, refresh, lose connection, an' rejoin with th' same account without another code—even after rotation or closin' Board Spell. Requirin' codes later won't undo earlier admissions; another voyage needs its own admission.
sections.warning: An in-class code an' short boardin' window help enforce attendance. A shared code or joined count ain't proof o' physical presence or stayin' aboard; check participation too an' follow yer institution's rules.

sections.title: Recap results, ledger consistently, an' communicate holler
sections.subtitle: After crew take part, Qlicker gives ye several ways to inspect outcomes an' reply.
bullets: Voyage recap lets ye inspect results, reply data, gradin' state, an' crew member summaries. Underway interactive voyages can be reviewed while they're still runnin', but gradin' stays locked until th' voyage ends. Response Data shows points only when a question has a real grade mark; a recorded zero still shows. Anonymous crew and ungraded guests get no point suffix. Responses by question uses the same question navigator and full preview as grading, with options, correct answers, and an optional solution, but no grade-editing controls.
Ledgers reveal turnout, automatic notches, an' manual-gradin' needs. Reckon anew ledgers when scorin' rules change or when ye want automatic results rebuilt.

Grading needs an Ended session, expired or removed extensions, and grade items, arrr. Ending creates grade items; scheduled quizzes close when visited after the last time window. Use Create grade items if they be missing. Nonblank short answers need grading until a score be saved, even zero. Only missing or blank answers get zero automatically. Publishing recalculates automatic grades and keeps manual marks.
Th' results tab now shows each crew member's actual voyage ledger afore turnout, an' clickin' a crew member's avatar in th' Crew tab opens th' larger dossier photo.
Ledger detail dialogs now label riddle rows with both number an' type, such as Q1(MC) or Q2(SA), an' spotlight rows that still need gradin' while ignorin' adrift zero-doubloon gradin' flags.
Crew get a bulletin when ye proclaim new holler, so use short, actionable remarks that tell 'em what to revisit.
If watch structures mattered durin' th' activity, compare th' recap an' gradin' data with th' ship watches so ye can spot uneven turnout patterns.

Joinin’ a course fills missin’ marks for finished activities, includin’ answers saved as a guest. Missed work earns zero with no reckonin’ needed; written answers may need reckonin’. Existing marks and feedback stay aboard. Anonymous activities stay ungraded.
The grade table averages the marks aboard the displayed sessions. Missing marks stay out; recorded zeros count. Use Select sessions with marks aboard, or pick sessions with No marks aboard by hand.
Only submitted quizzes be shown till this quiz ends, arrr. Once it ends, saved answers come aboard even if the student never hit submit.

In Response Data, Export CSV opens yer options. Tick Include response timestamps to add a time column for each question and attempt. ISO 8601 uses yer browser timezone and the offset on the response date, daylight saving included. Times mark the last answer save, or creation if needed, not the final quiz handover. Missing old timestamps stay blank. Anonymous activities never reveal response times, arr! The export keeps yer table search and sort order. The Joined Session CSV column uses the same format, arr! The tail -04:00 means four hours behind UTC, with daylight saving reckoned at the logged date. Missing join times stay blank.

In Results, the session timeline starts folded away and charts all questions and attempts together. Each question attempt gets its own expandable chart, with the range set by that attempt’s response timestamps alone, arr! Adjust Detail for finer or coarser intervals; hover, tap, or use arrow keys to inspect counts. Recorded responses set the range, gaps and answers beyond planned quiz dates included. Dotted lines mark planned dates inside the chart; outside dates are listed below. Quiz charts count each answer when last stowed, not every edit or final handover. Missing timestamps are tallied but left off the chart. Anonymous activities keep their timelines under wraps, arr!
sections.success: Professors can open th' crew member manual from th' switcher above to preview th' learner workflow afore class.

sections.title: Use course parley an' voyage parley with purpose
sections.subtitle: Course parley carries talk across th' term; voyage parley follows th' lesson happenin' now.
bullets: Hoist Course Chat an' choose how long to keep it in Course Settings. Then th' Course Chat tab appears fer both captains an' crew.
Course parley has titled, tagged topics with replies an' votes. Captains can filter, sort, an' archive; learners see anonymous role flags while captains keep th' names needed to moderate.
Hoist Session Chat from th' live-voyage controls. Ye may lower rich-text posts an' comments separately while quick posts tied to th' current riddle remain aboard.
Use votes to spot common questions, dismiss a settled thread without sinkin' it, an' inspect th' talk after th' voyage. Unseen counters warn ye while presentin'.
Set th' ship rules first: course parley fer lasting questions an' stores, voyage parley fer immediate confusion, an' answer controls fer graded responses.

Guests who’ve boarded a shared live activity can use its enabled session chat, quick posts, comments, and votes, arrr. This grants no passage to course chat. In anonymous activities, other crew and instructors cannot see guest or student identities in chat. Keep yer identity out of message text.
Session chat puts the freshest discussion atop the deck. A new post, comment, or upvote hoists it to the top, arrr. Unread badges clear when ye open Chat.
sections.note: Who sees a name depends on their role. Read th' learner manual before openin' parley to th' whole crew.

sections.title: Use AI fer course makin', reckonin', gradin', an' crew support
sections.subtitle: Qlicker keeps AI riggin', conversation tools, response summaries, an' gradin' in separate holds so ye command each use.
bullets: An admiral must authorize AI fer th' course before ye hoist AI Helper. AI Settings controls approved models, th' captain's default, tool-round limits, an' any course-only backend th' admiral permits.
Use AI Chat to inspect voyages, crew lists, riddles, responses, grade ledgers, an' course parley, or to create voyages an' riddles. Review every riddle branded Generated by AI before sailin' with it.
Edits to old voyages or riddles an' AI-written course posts stay as drafts. Read th' exact change an' send its shown approval phrase in a later message; th' helper carries no deletion tools.
In Session Review, make an AI response summary fer one riddle with a model an' saved order. Ye can watch, halt, remake, an' view it without changin' grades.
In Gradin', use th' AI Gradin' Assistant only after savin' separate grade an' learner-feedback orders. Inspect progress, report, log, points, an' feedback before revealin' results.
Keep an' copy reusable gradin', feedback, an' summary orders in AI Settings.
Learner AI Chat be a separate flag. Pick student-approved models, a default, guidance, an' a smaller tool-round limit; learners see only visible or reviewable course stores an' their own grades.
Save yer edited summary orders before generatin’. The chosen orders steer the language, focus, and format at every summary stage.
sections.warning: AI tales may be incomplete or false. Check made content, summaries, grades, feedback, dates, an' proposed deeds before trustin' them.

sections.title: Use th' dossier page fer tongue, secret word, an' avatar changes
sections.subtitle: Account rigging follow th' same institution-wide auth rules as crew member accounts.
bullets: Uploadin' a dossier picture opens a crop-an'-rotate dialog so ye can pick th' square avatar thumbnail afore savin'.
When institution-wide SSO be hoisted, yer moniker an' secret word fields stay locked unless an administrator has granted th' allow-missive-login exception fer yer account.
Secret word-reset missive follows th' same rule, so use th' SSO route or contact an administrator if th' dossier page says local missive login be struck.
In Profile, choose Daylight or Night Watch under Ship’s Colours. Yer choice saves itself and sails with yer account across voyages and devices.

student.title: Crew member hand manual
student.intro: Use this guide to sign aboard in ships, board underway activities, complete reckonings, recap holler, an' build yer own drill voyages.
student.summary: Yer ship page be th' best startin' doubloon because it separates underway activities, reckonings, drill voyages, recap links, an' chest content into clear tabs.
quickStart: Sign aboard with th' ship code from yer officer.
Open th' ship page an' check which tab has th' activity ye need right now.
Use recap pages an' drill voyages to turn holler into another round o' learnin'.

sections.title: Sign aboard in a ship an' learn th' ship tabs
sections.subtitle: Most crew member work begins from th' ship quarterdeck.
bullets: Enter th' boarding code exactly as yer officer gives it. If th' ship be mothballed, boarding be rejected an' ye'll need to try again after th' ship be activated. Search sessions starts unfurled and can be stowed.

Th' ship page separates sermons or underway voyages, reckonings, drill voyages, ledgers, an' riddle-chest material so ye can find th' right workflow quick. In ships where drill-riddle access be struck, th' drill an' chest tabs stay stowed away. Choose Ready fer review in the status filter to show only ended voyages yer captain has opened fer review. Draft be absent from the crew’s filter.
Voyage lists keep hunt, filters, an' pagination inside a collapsible Hunt voyages area so ye can expand controls only when ye need 'em.
If yer institution requires vouched fer missive or SSO, finish that setup first afore assumin' th' boarding code be wrong.
Ye usually only need th' board code once per ship. After it works, th' ship stays on yer quarterdeck until ye're removed or th' ship be buried fer yer account.
Watch th' badge on yer avatar in th' app bar fer afloat bulletins, then open Bulletins from th' account menu to read or wave off 'em.

Choose Join a voyage on yer dashboard and enter an S- code to open a quiz or live voyage without boarding its course. A live voyage may also demand its rotating boarding code. If ye have not boarded the course, yer replies be tracked but ye earn no marks. Enrolled mateys may earn marks in named voyages; masked voyages have no marks. Masked live reckonings and untied answer lists update after at least four new mateys answer the riddle and attempt. Names and answer times stay hidden. After the voyage ends, replies be released for each riddle and attempt with at least four mateys, tied across eligible riddles. Smaller crews show their true reply count with a hidden-replies notice; overall percentages stay hidden while any replies be withheld. A rare reply may still reveal someone. Activity codes won't work while the activity be a Draft, even fer past crewmates. The same code works once the captain publishes the activity.

Joinin’ a course fills missin’ marks for finished activities, includin’ answers saved as a guest. Missed work earns zero with no reckonin’ needed; written answers may need reckonin’. Existing marks and feedback stay aboard. Anonymous activities stay ungraded.

sections.title: Board underway voyages an' understand how reckonings differ
sections.subtitle: Interactive voyages, reckonings, an' drill voyages may look similar, but they behave differently.
bullets: Interactive voyages usually happen underway. Ye may need a secret code, an' yer officer decides when replies open, close, or reveal statistics. An individual extension lets ye open, save an’ submit an ended quiz durin’ yer assigned window. Yer course card shows yer deadline. Submitted quizzes stay locked; review waits until all extensions end.
Reckonings have a set time window an' normally expect ye to answer th' whole set afore final submission. Yer work saves while ye move between riddles.
Drill voyages be fer self-study an' can feel more flexible because they're built to help ye rehearse instead o' keepin' pace with a underway class.
Slides can appear between riddles. They're content pages, so read 'em carefully afore movin' on.
If yer officer reveals statistics fer a word cloud or histogram, th' view should amend automatically without a freshen.
Fer short-answer riddles, th' shared reply list can be revealed or stowed away separately from th' word cloud, so ye may see one without th' other.
Scroll o’er a numerical answer and its value stays put, matey. The input loses focus so the page can sail along. Click or tab back into the field to keep editing.
A Masked label means yer captain sees yer replies without yer name. Ye still sign aboard an' can answer each question but once, ye can review yer own replies later, an' the voyage earns no plunder.

If the captain moves a live voyage to Upcoming, mateys see a waitin’ screen till it sails Live again. Draft sends enrolled crew back to the course and guests to their dashboard. Saved answers stay aboard.

Fer an Upcomin’ interactive session, students can choose Open the waitin’ deck; guests can enter its S- activity code. Waitin’ records no attendance. The captain can still edit the session and require a live join code. When the session goes Live, crew wait fer a question or enter the code once the captain opens the join period.

sections.title: Use th' reply editor fer text, math, an' images when th' riddle allows it
sections.subtitle: Some riddles accept richer replies than plain text only.
bullets: Use th' editor toolbar only when it makes yer answer clearer, fer example a short list, emphasis, or a clean link.
Simple math examples include $\frac{1}{2}$, $x^2+1$, or \(\sum_{i=1}^{n} i\). Use display math fer expressions that deserve their own line.
If image uploads be available, attach clear photos or diagrams an' avoid unrelated background details.
Preview what ye typed when equations or symbols matter, because a small formatting mistake can change th' meanin' o' yer answer.

sections.title: Recap voyages one riddle at a time an' use holler
sections.subtitle: Recap mode be one o' th' best study tools in th' app.
bullets: Open recappable voyages from th' ship page after yer officer ends th' activity an' turns on recap. Click a grade in yer Grades table to open the session review.
Move one riddle at a time to compare yer answer, th' released answer, th' explanation, an' any officer holler without rushin' past details.
Watch fer holler bulletins because they tell ye when new remarks or gradin' updates be available.
Yer average marks and turnout use all visible marks, even from voyages closed fer review. Missing marks stay out; recorded zeros count. A mark opens voyage review only when Reviewable be on.
If no marks be released, yer averages show Not fer ye even if yer instructor has already marked yer work, arr!
sections.success: Crew often improve fastest when they read th' holler an' then immediately try a similar riddle again.

sections.title: Chart yer own drill voyages
sections.subtitle: Name a study voyage with riddle-chest questions or riddles ye write yerself.
bullets: Yer officer must enable drill-riddle access. If th' riddle chest an' drill-voyage tabs be missing, ask yer officer. Yer own private chest riddles can sail too.
Open yer ship's course, choose drill voyages, then chart a new one. Give it a required name, like “Cell biology — drill fer Quiz 2”, an' add voyage tags if ye wish.

Choose Add riddle → Copy from th' riddle chest. Search or filter, select riddles, an' add th' selected riddles to yer drill voyage. Fer a random haul, filter first, enter th' count, then choose random riddles from th' list.
Use Add riddle above, below, or between riddles to insert more. Remove takes a riddle out o' this voyage without sinking th' original in th' chest.

To write yer own, choose Add riddle → Create New, pick a type, an' fill in th' prompt, choices or expected answer, an' solution. Wait fer th' saved signal before closin' th' riddle editor. Ye can edit riddles ye own.
Save an' start practice to stow th' voyage an' open its recap. Try each riddle before showin' its solution. This be personal drill, separate from handin' in an officer's graded quiz.
Return to drill voyages to reopen yer set, edit its name or riddles, or delete it with confirmation. If savin' fails, check th' error an' required name before leavin' th' editor.
sections.note: Riddles save apart from th' voyage: cancellin' th' voyage editor won't undo riddle edits already stowed. Start with a small topic haul, then chart a mixed voyage with random selection.

sections.title: Use course parley an' voyage parley fer different questions
sections.subtitle: Course parley lasts across th' term; voyage parley follows a live lesson.
bullets: Th' Course Chat tab appears only when yer captain hoists it. Start a titled topic, add course tags, reply to a thread, or vote up a useful question.
Yer mates appear anonymous while captains keep th' names needed to moderate. Ye may edit or sink yer own posts when th' shown controls allow it.
During a live voyage, open th' Chat panel fer talk about th' current riddle. Quick posts remain when rich text be lowered; replies an' votes follow th' voyage settings.
A dismissed or archived yarn may still be kept. It be hidden from yer learner review, but th' captains may keep it fer review an' moderation.
A parley message does not submit yer answer. Return to Question an' use th' response button when grades or participation be counted.

Guests who’ve boarded a shared live activity can use its enabled session chat, quick posts, comments, and votes, arrr. This grants no passage to course chat. In anonymous activities, other crew and instructors cannot see guest or student identities in chat. Keep yer identity out of message text.
Session chat puts the freshest discussion atop the deck. A new post, comment, or upvote hoists it to the top, arrr. Unread badges clear when ye open Chat.

sections.title: Use learner AI Chat safely an' wisely
sections.subtitle: Learner AI Chat appears only when th' admiral an' yer captain enable an approved model fer th' course.
bullets: Start a separate yarn fer each study goal an' choose only approved models. Yer captain may give th' helper course-specific orders.

Th' helper can summarize th' visible voyage chart, inspect riddles an' solutions from reviewable voyages, an' explain yer own released grade an' feedback. It cannot reveal drafts, hidden solutions, or another learner's work.
Ask fer explanations, comparisons, study routes, or help readin' feedback. Name th' voyage or topic so th' helper finds th' right stores.
Made pictures, sounds, or files may expire. Save what ye be allowed to keep or ask fer it to be made again later.
Treat every answer as study aid, not th' official captain's orders or answer key. Check important claims against course stores.
sections.warning: Never paste secret words, private details, forbidden assessment answers, or other sensitive cargo into AI Chat.

sections.title: Amend yer dossier, tongue, an' avatar carefully
sections.subtitle: Dossier rigging depend on whether yer institution uses SSO fer th' account.
bullets: Uploadin' a dossier picture opens a crop-an'-rotate dialog so ye can position th' avatar circle afore savin'.
If institution-wide SSO be hoisted an' yer account hasn't been granted missive-login access, yer moniker an' secret word fields stay locked on purpose.
In that same SSO-managed case, secret word-reset missive be out o' reach until an administrator grants th' allow-missive-login exception fer yer account.
In Profile, choose Daylight or Night Watch under Ship’s Colours. Yer choice saves itself and sails with yer account across voyages and devices.
